notes: The booklet is a single page of small, low-detail renders, so the exact stacking order and which studs mate are inferred; ports are left null.

Step 1: black 4x4 (b1) with the dark bluish gray side-finger hinge (b2) under it. Step 2: four red 2-finger hinges (b3-b6) around the plate. Step 3: two more red hinges (b7,b8) and the two black 2x4 plates (b9,b10).

Step 4: light gray 2x2, handle plate and the two lever bases plus two orange plates. Step 5: a third orange plate (b17) and the red 1x3 (b18). Step 6: the two red wedge plates. Step 7: six black 1-finger hinges (b21-b26) as leg ends hinged to the red hinges, and the black 2x2 on top.

Step 8 inset: dark gray 2-finger hinge (b28), red 1x2 (b29), black 2x3 (b30) and two orange 1x2 (b31,b32) are built as a sub-assembly and attached to the left side of the body. Its exact attachment point is assumed (b30 on b9).
